title: Sources: Australia-founded Airwallex, which Keith Rabois accused of being a "Chinese backdoor", is relocating some staff out of China amid its US expansion (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Sources: Australia-founded Airwallex, which Keith Rabois accused of being a “Chinese backdoor”, is relocating some staff out of China amid its US expansion — Australia-founded Airwallex is pursuing US expansion amid intensifying rivalry between Washington and Beijing
